admissionExemptions.finding: hyperallergic.com serves three body paragraphs and then an inline registration wall reading 'Create a free account, or sign in to continue reading'. The remainder of the article is absent from the delivered HTML. This is a publisher change since 2026-08-12, not a classifier false positive.
admissionExemptions.decision: Published by explicit maintainer decision on 2026-08-18 despite failing the two-of-three admission gate.
admissionExemptions.consequence: The opt-in live verifier (-PverifyLiveSourceCatalog=true) fails while this source remains in the catalog and below the gate. Individual Hyperallergic articles still cannot reach Home: article eligibility is READY-only and independent of catalog membership.
